clinicalAnswers.questionText: Tell me what brings you to the hospital today. / आज आप किस तकलीफ के लिए आए हैं?
clinicalAnswers.answerText: Mujhe dono ghutno me pichhle 6 mahine se dard aur subah jakdan rehti hai. Sath hi khana khane ke baad pet me bhari-pan aur gas banti hai.
clinicalAnswers.voiceTranscript: मुझे दोनों घुटनों में पिछले 6 महीने से दर्द और सुबह जकड़न रहती है। साथ ही खाना खाने के बाद पेट में भारीपन और गैस बनती है।

clinicalAnswers.questionText: How severe is the joint pain on a daily basis?
clinicalAnswers.answerText: Moderate to Severe (Score: 6/10), worsens while climbing stairs and during cold weather.

clinicalAnswers.questionText: Do you experience morning stiffness, and for how long?
clinicalAnswers.answerText: Yes, about 30 to 45 minutes every morning (Sandhi Stambha).

clinicalAnswers.questionText: How is your appetite and bowel habit? (Agni & Koshtha assessment)
clinicalAnswers.answerText: Appetite is irregular (Vishamagni). Irregular bowel movements, prone to constipation and dry stools.
clinicalAnswers.voiceTranscript: भूख कभी लगती है कभी नहीं लगती। पेट साफ ठीक से नहीं होता, कब्ज रहता है।

clinicalAnswers.questionText: Are you currently taking any regular medications?
clinicalAnswers.answerText: Tab Amlodipine 5mg once daily for Hypertension. Occasionally Tab Paracetamol 650mg for knee pain relief.
clinicalAnswers.voiceTranscript: बीपी की गोली खाती हूँ एमलोडिपिन 5 मिलीग्राम रोज। घुटने के दर्द के लिए कभी-कभी पैरासिटामोल ले लेती हूँ।

aiSummaries.patientSnapshot: 62-year-old male presenting with दोनों घुटने. Underlying essential hypertension on regular therapy and mild digestive irregularity.
aiSummaries.historyOfPresentIllness: Patient reports insidious onset of bilateral knee discomfort for the past 6 months. Symptoms are characterized by deep aching and morning stiffness lasting ~30-45 minutes. Aggravated by cold weather, climbing stairs, and prolonged standing. Partially relieved by warm oil application and rest. Associated with audible crepitus during bending.
familyHistory: Mother had history of chronic joint pains (Sandhigata Vata)

personalHistory.diet: Vegetarian, prefers warm cooked meals, irregular timings (Vishamashana)
personalHistory.sleep: Disturbed sleep due to joint aching (approx 5-6 hours/night)
personalHistory.bowel: Irregular, hard stools, tendency towards constipation (Krura Koshtha)
personalHistory.physicalActivity: Sedentary due to bilateral knee stiffness.

reviewOfSystems.Musculoskeletal: Bilateral knee joint pain, crepitus, morning stiffness (30-45 min). No small joint involvement.
reviewOfSystems.Cardiovascular: Controlled blood pressure (128/84 mmHg). No chest pain, palpitations, or orthopnea.
reviewOfSystems.Gastrointestinal: Post-meal bloating and constipation. No acid regurgitation or hematemesis.
reviewOfSystems.Neurological: No dizziness, focal weakness, or sensory deficits.
